judge.note: 重复判分实测:满分参考件 3 遍逐条一致,但真实答卷在判定边界上不稳——同一份答卷两轮之间 M-12/M-15/M-18/M-19 各有翻转(每条 3–4 分)。挂闸的 7 条实测 3:0 一致,故 gate 不受噪声影响。votes=3 取多数;换判官须重测。正夹具不外发,其 judge 层用 declare 声明值。

readings.latest: requirement (ii) measured on the most recent completed year
readings.every: requirement (ii) met in every year of the five-year window

meta.reading_rule: 凡带 by_reading 的判据,按答卷自己采用的读法取期望值;带 readings 的判据只在所列读法下计入分母。读法由脚本按最佳拟合判定。

equiv_basis.note: 份额可写成 % / 金额($M) / 倍数;CO2E 可写 kt 或 t。同一个量的不同单位形式都算对——脚本轨措辞不计分,单位形式亦是措辞。

citation_precision.note: 引到父条款(如 7-020(1) 顶 7-020(1)(c))给分,但按数量分档扣分,见 S-N1;祖父级不认。

meta.scoring: raw = (Σ命中正分权重 − Σ命中负分权重) / Σ适用正分权重;final = max(0,raw) × min(触发 gate 的 mult),取 min 不叠乘
meta.changelog: v2 相对 v1:①脚本轨 79→135,新增真实负担离散度(S-BD-*)、两处定义陷阱(S-D1/D2/D3)、反事实基数(S-X1/X2/X3)、两基数差额补全(S-AD-*)、财产费基数(S-PF*)、联邦补助归属(S-B5);S-C3 升权 4→8,S-T-* 因分母口径歧义降权 2→1。②修 v1 两处缺陷:S-R1/S-R2 原为同值同条款重复计分,S-R2 改为「最早一笔受计销售距生效日 63 months」;S-B4/S-P5 锚定的 630 与联邦award 记录存在口径张力,不改锚值,改以 S-B5/M-26 奖励拆解。③模型轨 70→97,新增 M-21..M-27,锐化 M-06/M-13/M-15/M-16(由「提到即得分」改为「结论正确且排除错答法」)。④负分 -14→-33,新增 M-N5..M-N11,其中 M-N9(把失衡放进商业条款第四支)是 M-07 的镜像。⑤新增闸门 G4/G5/G6a/G6b/G7,G2 乘数 0.45→0.35 并挂 M-21 与 M-N9。
meta.limitations: ①闸门阈值系对单一参考答卷标定(2026-09-20 盲测件,v1 下 raw 0.669):脚本轨命中为官方判分器实测,模型轨为人工估计。换一份失败模式不同的答卷,闸门覆盖面未经验证。②final=0.2 一档是刻度而非对答卷可用性的陈述——该参考答卷在 v1 下脚本轨 37/79、四闸全过,把它压到 0.2 是乘数的结果。③本题在 0.2 附近区分的主要是算术完成度;法律推理质量仅通过 raw 与 G1/G2 体现。④脚本轨只读 Schedule A 的 Value 栏,数值写在 Derivation 栏不计分;闸门判据已筛选为「必须独立推导才可能出现」的量,以降低格式税占比,但未能消除。

criteria.statement: Drafting defects and constitutional exposures are kept distinct

model.question: Does the memorandum keep the drafting defects separate from the constitutional exposures, rather than treating a provision that fails to achieve its purpose as being for that reason unconstitutional?
model.reference: That requirement (iii) cannot reach the largest sellers defeats the bill's stated purpose; it is not for that reason a constitutional defect. A memorandum may advance a uniformity or rational-basis argument about the classification, but it must be advanced as such and not derived from the failure of purpose. criteria.statement: The retroactive reach is measured against the governing authority

model.question: Does the memorandum state the length of the reach-back in months and measure it against the authority on retroactive taxation and against the reach-backs of the enacted measures in the file?
model.reference: The measuring period is 60 months and the earliest chargeable sale lies 63 months before the effective date. United States v. Carlton, 512 U.S. 26, 32-33 (1994) relied on Congress having 'established only a modest period of retroactivity'; Welch v. Henry treats the length as material. The research note in the file reports enacted reach-backs of two to five years and none longer. A memorandum that says only 'five years' without setting it against the authority has not measured it.
model.pass_fail: PASS = the question is answered yes on the material in the work product; FAIL = it is not. Do not credit intent.

criteria.statement: The source and character of the State's authority is addressed

model.question: Does the memorandum state the source of the State's power to impose these charges, say in terms that the assessment is not a fee for any service or benefit conferred, and explain how the characterisation as a tax or as a remedial exaction changes the standard applied?
model.reference: The police and conservation powers in Article IX, section 1 supply the authority. The assessment is measured by past sales and confers nothing on the payer, so it is not a user fee. If it is a tax, the state-tax framework applies; if it is remedial, the analysis borrows from the retroactivity cases and the State does better where it can show the charge tracking a measure of the harm. Naming the powers without addressing the characterisation, or vice versa, is not a hit.
model.pass_fail: PASS = the question is answered yes on the material in the work product; FAIL = it is not. Do not credit intent.

model.question: Does the memorandum place the objection to the size of the assessment under the Due Process Clause rather than under the Commerce Clause, and note that the fourth limb of the state-tax test does not turn on the amount of the charge?
model.reference: Commonwealth Edison Co. v. Montana, 453 U.S. 609, 626 (1981) holds that the relevant inquiry under the fourth prong of Complete Auto is not the amount of the tax or the value of the benefits bestowed. A memorandum that argues the charge is too large to satisfy the fourth prong has put the strongest point in the weakest place. The size argument belongs to the retroactivity and proportionality authorities (Carlton; Eastern Enterprises).

model.reference: Section 7-019(j) defines Combustion as occurring 'whether or not within the State', and the opening words of 7-020(1) refer to products 'sold by any entity' without geographic limit; only (1)(a) and (1)(b) confine it. Internal consistency (Oklahoma Tax Commission v. Jefferson Lines, 514 U.S. 175, 185) fails if an identical charge in every State would tax the same sale repeatedly. Confining the measure also puts the State in the source-State posture for preemption purposes.

gates.why: 基础要件:无建议、结论不挂条款、附表无依据 → 州长无法据以行动。分值只 1–2 分但挂闸
把歧视主张当主结论 → 结论方向错,据此否决法案是错的建议。前面的测算尚有参考价值
失衡是真正的主暴露；没抓到或算错 → 州长会签下一部会被推翻的法案。与 G6a 取同一乘数：覆盖门槛与失衡比是同一条脊柱上的两端。M-21 并入 criteria、M-N9 挂 also_fires_if_negative：把失衡放进商业条款第四支与没抓到失衡，对州长是同一种错建议。
覆盖判定错 → 后面所有份额与比值的分母都错,整份附表不可用。只挂确定性判据 S-M1（家数,脚本算）:M-01 实测在两份答卷上判官 2:1 分裂（「只用加数隐含给出名单」算不算给出),把 ×0.6 的开关交给会分裂的判断本身是缺陷。M-01 仍作 5 分正分,噪声只影响 raw 的 ±5/148,不再影响乘数

覆盖判定的门槛额一条没落地。S-C1/S-C2 是 (k)(iii) 那两个「机制性」数字——它们才是说明为什么十家里只进六家、最大的州内卖家反被排除的那组数（与 M-02 同一考点）。附表里没有它们,等于覆盖结论没有证据支撑,而后面每一个份额/比值都建在这个集合上。比 G2 更狠:分母错了比值再对也没有意义。只挂 S-C1 不挂 S-C2：Kestrel 是机制的头部实例，Halbrook 的同一笔计算是记账不是洞察；两条都挂会让「算了 Kestrel 没算 Halbrook」与「一条都没算」同档，误伤。
门槛算出来了,但没换算成全州最近一年销售额的占比。占比才揭示门槛的非单调性——门槛越高,被排除的越大卖家越多,负担越集中在留下来的人身上。缺这一步,「负担失衡」的因果链断在中间。
7-020(2) 的年收入是条公式（Gross Revenue × 费率）。抄了材料里的旧数、没有按定义重算 → 年费规模错,与财产费年收入的对比(S-P10)跟着错。
溯及长度与资格日的空档都没有量化。溯及期是 Carlton 分析里第一位的尺度,算不出月数就说不清「acted promptly」这一支能不能站住;资格日与测算期错开的 6 个月又是修法意见书的直接依据。
记录纪律:把陈旧的财政说明数字当成自己的结论,或对先占诉讼给出预测——两者都是题面与卷内备忘录明文禁止的。不挂 must-hit 判据,只由负分触发。
